prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Pasadena, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1217; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my name on a recording, but you can reference the claim file.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was in a parking lot at a shopping center in Pasadena, Texas. I'd just pulled into a space near the entrance when another vehicle backed out of the spot next to me.

Q: Which part of your vehicle was struck?

A: The driver's side rear door and quarter panel. The other car's rear bumper hit me as it reversed.

Q: Were you moving at the time?

A: No, I had already stopped and turned off my engine. I was getting my bag out of the back seat.

Q: Did you have any contact with the other driver afterward?

A: Yes, she got out and apologized right away. She said she didn't see me because of the pillar on her side.

Q: When did you first notice an injury?

A: My knee started hurting almost immediately, but I thought it was just from twisting when the car jolted. By that evening it was swollen and I could barely bend it.

Q: Have you seen a doctor for the knee?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care the next morning. They took X-rays and told me to follow up with an orthopedist.

Q: Had you injured that knee before this incident?

A: I had some soreness a couple of years ago after playing softball, but it had resolved and I hadn't had treatment since.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I'm still having trouble with stairs and I'd like to know what the next steps are for my medical bills.

Q: Understood. We'll review the file and follow up with you. Thank you for your time.
